objective: Stop Ron System background/PWA polling from continuously waking Neon while preserving exact known deadline/reminder execution, player feedback, Growth follow-through, push delivery, and direct-controller continuity.

roles_before.artifact: Neon/PostgreSQL system_events remains the single mutable owner of derived RPG state.
deadline-engine.mjs generates deadline/recommended-window notifications and terminal expiry/recovery.
execution-reminder.mjs fires persisted reminder.scheduled events without requiring an open PWA.
growth-engine.mjs applies evidence-gated Growth/Skill Mastery follow-through.
player-feedback-engine.mjs converts verified progression/achievement events into deterministic player notifications.
push-delivery.mjs + delivery tables provide Web Push delivery and retry semantics.
The PWA reads /api/v1/snapshot and refreshes after actions/visibility/online changes.
ChatGPT may apply authorized System mutations directly through Neon and must read back authoritative ledger state.
Neon Free compute uses 0.25 CU and the plan-default 5-minute idle window; 30-second background queries currently prevent idle suspension.
Git history, append-only system_events and architecture manifests preserve recovery/provenance.
system-cloud-ci, system-pwa-ci, continuity-guard and architecture guard protect runtime and controller behavior.

role_dispositions.destination: All automation still reads/writes through the same Neon event ledger and shared action gate.
Replace fixed 30-second polling with an idle-aware coordinator that schedules the next known deadline/recommended-window boundary exactly and uses a sparse reconciliation safety wake.
Replace fixed polling with exact next-remind_at timers plus the same sparse reconciliation safety wake.
Run Growth at startup and on observed/new System events instead of unconditional 30-second polling; policy/evidence semantics remain unchanged.
Run feedback at startup and on observed/new progression/achievement events instead of unconditional 30-second polling; deterministic producer semantics remain unchanged.
Remove unconditional 30-second delivery polling; drain on new notifications/startup and preserve bounded retries through event-aware scheduling.
Remove the 30-second visible-tab snapshot poll; retain initial/action/visibility/online refreshes so an idle open PWA does not pin Neon awake.
After a direct Neon System mutation and exact ledger read-back, the controller performs one canonical public snapshot read so the idle-aware runtime observes and schedules new time-sensitive state.
Runtime traffic becomes event/timer driven with a 12-hour reconciliation safety bound, creating idle gaps much longer than Neon's fixed 5-minute Free-plan suspend window.
No destructive data/schema migration; prior polling behavior remains recoverable in Git and all ledger events remain intact.
Add deterministic wake-planning/coordinator tests and static guards that reject reintroduction of production 30-second database polling.

capability_probes.assertion: A known active deadline/recommended-window or explicit execution reminder still schedules the correct next server wake and fires through the existing idempotent action/push path.

With no due work and no user/controller activity, production runtime and visible PWA code contain no 30-second database/snapshot polling path; the next safety reconciliation is hours, not seconds, away.
Verified progression/achievement/Growth follow-through still runs after API/direct-controller-observed mutations and does not change reward/evidence semantics.
Web Push still sends immediately for new notifications and failed deliveries retain bounded retry behavior without global polling.
A direct Neon mutation followed by required ledger read-back + one public snapshot read refreshes the runtime scheduler without creating a second state owner.
The polling implementation and all pre-change runtime behavior remain recoverable from Git; no Neon state is deleted or rewritten.

tests.expected: Next-wake planning, idle coordinator, push retry scheduling and no-polling runtime/PWA guards PASS alongside all existing cloud tests.
Quest/Challenge/timing/reminder/Growth/player-feedback/push/PWA/controller contracts remain green and Architecture Mode guard accepts the candidate.

verification.base_head_diff: Replaced five 30-second server database loops and the visible-PWA 30-second snapshot loop with one event/timer-driven coordinator. Event-ledger ownership, action gate, Quest/Challenge/reward/evidence semantics, push transport, rollback history, and user-facing capabilities remain intact.
